notes: The copula *is* goes to the predicate noun ʾāreṣ rather than to the demonstrative subject (rule 20).
*yet* before *remaineth* is added, as at JOS.13.1; the attributive article takes the relative *that* under rule 41.
Both *the*s are written, so the article on the rectum takes the one before its own word and the construct a supplied one (rule 29).
